acceptance: The external-review signal requires a listed reviewer or attester account
A test shows a comment from another author is not counted
context: Done in #2798 (merged 2026-10-09, 7b639aba1). review_signals counts an external-review note only from a STANDIN_ATTESTERS user account. Tests cover another author, a Bot account and an untyped account, and a mutation that drops the check fails them.
description: soundness_merge_digest.EXTERNAL_REVIEW_PATTERN matches the review text in a comment from any commenter, so anyone who can comment can make a merged soundness change look reviewed in the daily digest.
